projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Developer environments, low-level experiments, and shipped products — the work I keep coming back to.
projects.dotfilesDescription: A multi-platform development environment with automated installation and a shared design language across shells, terminals, editors, Linux, and macOS.
projects.nyanvimDescription: A small, fast Neovim setup: IDE features out of the box, ~30 ms startup, a live theme switcher, and a try-before-you-switch installer that leaves your own config untouched. About 1,200 lines of Lua, one plugin per file.
projects.nyanphotosDescription: A macOS app that sorts your Apple Photos library by what the pictures are: screenshots, documents, anime art, tiny or low-resolution files, duplicates and bursts. Every label comes from on-device Vision and image embeddings, nothing leaves the Mac, and every change goes through a review sheet before Photos is touched.
projects.contextforgeDescription: A Claude Code plugin that keeps the agent's context small: a status line with a live context bar and CLAUDE.md token estimate, a session-start hook that warns when an instruction file grows past 600 words, and 11 skills for trimming it further — six of them also run on Codex and Gemini CLI.
projects.kitvcsDescription: A Git-inspired version-control system built in C++ to explore object storage, commits, branches, and command-line tool design.
projects.NomadXDescription: A fintech and NFT marketplace for Mongolian creators, delivered across web and mobile as part of the Sod Mongol Group engineering team.
projects.skinmarketDescription: A marketplace for buying and selling Steam skins in Mongolia: live item listings and prices, Steam login, and local payment in MNT.
projects.mcosmeticsDescription: Online store for a Mongolian cosmetics brand: product catalog, cart and checkout, and an admin panel for stock and orders.
projects.mongolnetDescription: A national social-network and marketplace platform for Mongolian communities, developed across web, backend, and mobile applications.
projects.madoka_reactDescription: An interactive animation and visual-design study built with React and Sass, exploring expressive motion and interface composition — the design language this site is built on.
